title: Sun, Moon, and Stars
notes: This chunk builds the sun-moon-stars household with strong Hebrew anchors (gadol/qaton, kisse/keseh, neged) and a tight Joseph-dream application. The sun-as-Father and moon-as-faithful-witness case is dense, assertive, and law-positive. Main defects are house-style sentence opens: several author sentences begin with And or That, plus one clear director cue (Mark where). Mild reader-meta staging appears once. Residual And-opens remain after these eight fixes; no doctrine disputes or mistyped scripture quotes found.

This chunk builds a tight chain from stars-as-righteous through Mazzaroth and the twelve tribes, the bridal clothing of Revelation 12, the relay of light offices, and the elders seated among the host. Strengths are the dense Hebrew work on nes/kether/rosh/echad, the Exodus 21 covering statute applied to the sky, and the clean office-not-person resolution of dual sun/moon titles. Issues cluster as house-style sentence-open And/That starts, two residual director cues (Note how; Hold the offices), one mild hedge, and a tangled relative clause on the sun standing in Virgo. Surgical fixes restore the bans without touching doctrine or quoted Scripture.

This chunk tightly chains the four beasts, eyes as lamps, and stars into the heavenly court and Mazzaroth, with a clean tribal-triad table and strong dual-witness treatment of Jude 13 against Enoch and Isaiah. Planetary marks for Tzedeq and Chiun are asserted densely from Scripture without fluff or modernism. Residual defects are house-style only: two author sentences open with And, and several director cues remain (Now we know, Now stand, Look at, Read with, so set), plus a 'weighing' that echoes forbidden staging. No grammar errors, AI vocabulary, broken math, or quote mistypes. The final sentence softens slightly with 'we will discover'.

proposals.old: And the stakes are not academic: __“He appointed the *moon* for *seasons*”__ (Psalm 104:19) — the appointed times — and the announcement of the sym:sym-gospel[gospel] itself carries the command to keep them:
proposals.new: The stakes are not academic: __“He appointed the *moon* for *seasons*”__ (Psalm 104:19) — the appointed times — and the announcement of the sym:sym-gospel[gospel] itself carries the command to keep them:
proposals.summary: Drop leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences opening with And. Removing it leaves the claim intact and assertive.

proposals.old: Mark where the verse sets the perfection: not on the Father alone, but on what stands *with* Him — the Greek is _par’ hō_, *beside whom*.
proposals.new: The verse sets the perfection not on the Father alone, but on what stands *with* Him — the Greek is _par’ hō_, *beside whom*.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids presenter staging such as Mark that / Mark where. The claim stands cleaner as a direct assertion.

proposals.old: And the Son of man *has* a face in the sky, by the Lord's own word:
proposals.new: The Son of man *has* a face in the sky, by the Lord's own word:
proposals.summary: Drop leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not open with And. The identification and lead-in to the quote remain unchanged.

proposals.old: A *sign* that *appears in heaven* — the fourth day's own vocabulary again, a sign of the lights — and the reader of this chapter now knows which face it is: the full, unshadowed witness.
proposals.new: A *sign* that *appears in heaven* — the fourth day's own vocabulary again, a sign of the lights — and the face is the full, unshadowed witness.
proposals.summary: Drop reader-meta staging; assert the face directly.
proposals.rationale: the reader of this chapter now knows is presenter meta-talk. Asserting the face keeps density and the author's voice.

proposals.old: That mark matters: a perfect and complete gift bears *no shadow of turning* — it will divide the true sign from the counterfeit when the counterfeit appears.
proposals.new: The mark matters: a perfect and complete gift bears *no shadow of turning* — it will divide the true sign from the counterfeit when the counterfeit appears.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author prose sentences opening with That. The mark remains the subject of the same claim.

proposals.old: That is the Son exactly: __“The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do”__ (John 5:19); __“I am the light of the world”__ (John 8:12) — light reflected, not self-made, the Father's light carried faithfully into the dark.
proposals.new: The Son is that light exactly: __“The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do”__ (John 5:19); __“I am the light of the world”__ (John 8:12) — light reflected, not self-made, the Father's light carried faithfully into the dark.
proposals.summary: Rewrite opening to avoid That while keeping the identification.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not open with That. The new form asserts the same moon-to-Son match without the banned open.

proposals.old: And one light keeps the verse's exact hours: the full moon rises as the sun sets and does not set until the day dawns — sunset to sunrise, the whole watch of the dark — the timetable of the promise hung in the sky.
proposals.new: One light keeps the verse's exact hours: the full moon rises as the sun sets and does not set until the day dawns — sunset to sunrise, the whole watch of the dark — the timetable of the promise hung in the sky.
proposals.summary: Drop leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences opening with And. The full-moon timetable claim is unchanged.

proposals.old: And that is why the night is given governors at all: the moon and the stars are set *over* the night, the Son and His righteous carrying His light to the people in the dark.
proposals.new: The night is given governors for this reason: the moon and the stars are set *over* the night, the Son and His righteous carrying His light to the people in the dark.
proposals.summary: Rewrite to avoid And/That open while keeping the causal claim.
proposals.rationale: The line opened with And and carried That-pattern staging. The rephrase asserts the same reason without banned sentence opens.

proposals.old: Note how a star shines, for it is not the moon's way.
proposals.new: A star shines in a way the moon does not.
proposals.rationale: House style bans Notice/Note director cues; the claim stands stronger as a direct assertion of the star-moon contrast.

proposals.old: That too is exact.
proposals.new: The figure is exact.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not open with That; the rewrite keeps the same force and points to the star/heart parallel.

proposals.old: Hold the offices together and a question surfaces that must be settled before the counterfeit: this chapter read the sym:sym-sun[sun] as the Father — yet Malachi calls the Son __“the *Sun* of righteousness”__ (Malachi 4:2); it read the sym:sym-moon[moon] as the Son — yet Joseph's dream read her as the *mother*, and the sym:sym-pearl[Pearls of Wisdom] chapter will price her as the pearl.
proposals.new: The offices held together raise a question that must be settled before the counterfeit: this chapter read the sym:sym-sun[sun] as the Father — yet Malachi calls the Son __“the *Sun* of righteousness”__ (Malachi 4:2); it read the sym:sym-moon[moon] as the Son — yet Joseph's dream read her as the *mother*, and the sym:sym-pearl[Pearls of Wisdom] chapter will price her as the pearl.
proposals.rationale: Hold the offices is a presenter stage direction banned by house style; the rewrite keeps the logical move without the cue.

proposals.old: And the verse announces itself in the fourth day's own vocabulary: a *great sign in the heavens* — the words of the two *great* lights set in the heavens __“for sym:sym-sign[signs], and for seasons”__ (Genesis 1:14-16); what John saw is one of the signs the lights were hung to give.
proposals.new: The verse announces itself in the fourth day's own vocabulary: a *great sign in the heavens* — the words of the two *great* lights set in the heavens __“for sym:sym-sign[signs], and for seasons”__ (Genesis 1:14-16); what John saw is one of the signs the lights were hung to give.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids And at the start of author prose sentences.

proposals.old: And _echad_ stands twice in the sentence — *one, a certain, first*, the word of __“the *first* day”__ (Genesis 1:5) — once counting the woman, and once, with _min_, ranking her: *first of the twelve*.
proposals.new: The word _echad_ stands twice in the sentence — *one, a certain, first*, the word of __“the *first* day”__ (Genesis 1:5) — once counting the woman, and once, with _min_, ranking her: *first of the twelve*.
proposals.rationale: Opening with And violates house style; The word _echad_ preserves the Hebrew focus cleanly.

proposals.old: If any doubt remains, Isaiah names the day that settles it:
proposals.new: Isaiah names the day that settles it:
proposals.rationale: House style forbids hedging; the assertion is stronger without the doubt-concession.

proposals.old: And the promise to the stars is the sun's own brightness: __“Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father”__ (Matthew 13:43).
proposals.new: The promise to the stars is the sun's own brightness: __“Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father”__ (Matthew 13:43).
proposals.rationale: House style forbids And at sentence start in author prose.

proposals.old: Not by the sun standing in her — a figure the sun stands in rides the sky by day, washed invisible in his glare, a sign no eye could ever see — but by the *full* sym:sym-moon[moon] standing in her, delivering the whole of the sun's light from directly opposite: the Bridegroom clothing his bride — a relay this chapter is about to draw whole.
proposals.new: Not by the sun standing in her — a figure in which the sun stands rides the sky by day, washed invisible in his glare, a sign no eye could ever see — but by the *full* sym:sym-moon[moon] standing in her, delivering the whole of the sun's light from directly opposite: the Bridegroom clothing his bride — a relay this chapter is about to draw whole.
proposals.summary: Insert relative in which for readable grammar.
proposals.rationale: a figure the sun stands in rides is tangled and hard to parse; the relative clause makes the daytime-invisibility claim immediate without changing meaning.

proposals.old: And a dwelling has doors.
proposals.new: A dwelling has doors.
proposals.summary: Remove prohibited And-start in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences opening with And. The claim stands cleanly without it.

proposals.old: Now we know who His eyes are: the burning ones, His righteous, sent __“to and fro through the whole earth.”__
proposals.new: His eyes are the burning ones, His righteous, sent __“to and fro through the whole earth.”__
proposals.rationale: Director cue violates house style. Direct assertion keeps the author's density and law-positive voice.

proposals.old: Now stand outside on a clear night and say what you see: figures of animals — a lion, a bull, an eagle among them — drawn in points of light, wheeling through the whole earth in their seasons.
proposals.new: On a clear night the figures of animals appear — a lion, a bull, an eagle among them — drawn in points of light, wheeling through the whole earth in their seasons.
proposals.summary: Remove 'Now stand... and say what you see' director cue.
proposals.rationale: Imperative staging is forbidden. Assertive rephrase preserves the exact claim and images.

proposals.old: One verse seems to curse the wanderers, so set its two witnesses side by side.
proposals.new: One verse seems to curse the wanderers; its two witnesses stand side by side.
proposals.rationale: Director instruction violates house style. Parallel structure keeps the dual-witness setup intact.

proposals.old: Read with the source Jude himself quotes, the two witnesses agree: the Hebrew condemns the wicked in Isaiah's storm-waves, the Greek condemns the same men in Enoch's time-breaking stars — and the charge inside the star-figure is precisely this book's charge, the abandoning of the appointed times.
proposals.new: The source Jude himself quotes shows the two witnesses agree: the Hebrew condemns the wicked in Isaiah's storm-waves, the Greek condemns the same men in Enoch's time-breaking stars — and the charge inside the star-figure is precisely this book's charge, the abandoning of the appointed times.
proposals.rationale: Forbidden presenter staging. Assertive lead-in keeps the identical logic and density.

proposals.old: No planet is condemned for lawful wandering — the wanderers keep their circuits and their seasons — and two of them carry the two claims this chapter has been weighing.
proposals.new: No planet is condemned for lawful wandering — the wanderers keep their circuits and their seasons — and two of them carry the two claims this chapter has set out.
proposals.rationale: Echoes the forbidden 'Weigh the' cue. 'Set out' is assertive and matches the author's voice.

proposals.old: And *King of Righteousness* is a title with an Owner: _Malki-Tzedek_, __“first being by interpretation *King of righteousness*”__ (Hebrews 7:2) — the priest-king whose order the Messiah holds for ever: __“Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek”__ (Psalm 110:4).
proposals.new: *King of Righteousness* is a title with an Owner: _Malki-Tzedek_, __“first being by interpretation *King of righteousness*”__ (Hebrews 7:2) — the priest-king whose order the Messiah holds for ever: __“Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek”__ (Psalm 110:4).
proposals.summary: Remove prohibited And-start in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences opening with And. The identification remains unchanged.

proposals.old: Look at it through any glass: it wears *stripes* across its whole face; it bears one great *wound* in its side; and its color is the red-orange of a sardius stone.
proposals.new: Through any glass it wears *stripes* across its whole face; it bears one great *wound* in its side; and its color is the red-orange of a sardius stone.
proposals.rationale: Imperative staging is forbidden. The marks and sardius claim stay identical and dense.
